settings.editor: Stretch wrapping, strapping, hooding, palletising and case packing from Atlanta Stretch, Area Packaging, Messersi and partners, with consumables and local support.
Stable loads, less film. Atlanta Stretch pallet wrappers for every output level, from mobile robots for low volumes to fully automatic ring machines for high-speed lines.

settings.title: Atlanta Stretch · Area Packaging · Fully auto

settings.editor: Accurate fills, clean bags. Filling systems for powders, granules and bulk products, built to feed straight into your palletising line.
Square, stable pallets every time. Conventional palletisers that stack cases and bags into tight, consistent loads ready for wrapping.
Flexible automation for mixed lines. Robot cells that handle multiple products, patterns and lines with quick, recipe-based changeovers.
Secure bundles and pallets. Messersi strapping systems with the MS300 head, running PP and PET strap for loads of every size.
Fast, reliable case sealing. Tape and hot-melt sealers for fixed or mixed carton sizes, from semi-automatic to fully in-line.
Five-sided, weatherproof protection. Hooding systems that cover the whole pallet, ideal for loads stored outdoors or shipped long distances.
Products packed and ready to ship. Atlanta case packers that pack bottles, cans and packs into cartons and trays at line speed.
The right strap and film for your machine. PP, PET and steel strap plus stretch film, matched to your equipment so it runs the way it should.
A system designed around your line. We assess your product, floor space and output, then design and integrate the right end-of-line system.

Tell us the machine or application you are interested in and we will send the specification sheet, pricing and lead time. Not sure which machine suits your loads? Describe them and our specialists will recommend one.
